# RS Handelsvertretung

> Independent commercial agent (Handelsvertreter) based in Menziken, Switzerland, working worldwide on commission only.
> Connects manufacturers with business customers and public buyers, finds checked suppliers for buyers, and helps
> manufacturers find, check and submit offers for public and private tenders (forms, translation, questions, submission).

- Owner: Rajinder Singh · Languages: German, French, English, Hindi, Punjabi · Contact: info@rshandelsvertretung.com
- Fees: no retainer, no upfront costs; commission only when a deal is closed, paid by the seller; free for buyers.
- Product areas: machinery and equipment, precision and metal parts, plastics technology (moulds, ultrasonic welders, film
  lines, dosing units), electronics, medical and lab equipment, wood and furniture, packaging.
